args.prompt: A creative agency at deadline time in the evening: colleagues rushing past in motion blur, post-its and moodboards on the wall, in the middle a young Brazilian designer around 28 sits still in front of two monitors, exhausted, drained empty expression, the only sharp person in the frame. Candid documentary photograph, natural light, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, warm natural colors, realistic skin texture, modern Brazilian corporate workplace, genuine emotion, not posed like a stock photo, subject in the upper two thirds of the frame, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
